candidates.evidence: Historical primary search metadata and attributed recent third-party counters; actual structural analyses of supplied references are reused separately.
candidates.limitations: No verified current platform-wide rank, comparable channel winner, guaranteed views or reuse grant from competitor results.

unqualified_for_automatic_expansion: new formats selected only from a viral title or unverified chart

latest_check.interpretation: No fresh audience/velocity or mature own-channel comparison; no allocation change. Catalog item counts are not audience metrics. Existing motivational/character formats remain small explorations.
